dex.text: Digs neat square holes in the marsh for no reason it can explain, and stacks the turves in rows to dry. Very tidy. Slightly worrying.
dex.fact: Medieval Norfolk dug millions of tonnes of peat for fuel; Norwich Cathedral's priory alone burnt hundreds of thousands of turves a year.

dex.text: Wherever it lies down for long, the hollow fills with water and becomes a lake. Ducks follow it about in hope. Holidaymakers moor on it.
dex.fact: The Broads were thought to be natural lakes until the 1950s, when the botanist Joyce Lambert showed their steep straight sides were the walls of medieval peat pits.
